name: Karancsság (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of red over blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Karancsság: a crowned blue and red shield with a white church, above a scroll inscribed KARANCSSÁG.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Karancsság arms with crown and scroll
